$1K → $500K | 90-DAY JOURNEY

WEEK 1 : 14th October -21st October  
BUILD THE MACHINE

Capital: Build the first $1,000 myself. Friends offered to help, but I want to do it the hard way. Collect every forgotten $10–$20 across 50+ wallets. 

Watchlist: Build one master watchlist and actually maintain it. Ticker, chain, MC, narrative, catalyst, wallets, entry range, invalidation + one question: What is the market not pricing?

Focus: Only RH, BASE, SOL & BNB. My attention is capital too. Not chasing the 15th ecosystem because someone posted a crazy PnL.

Information: Clean X lists, Telegram, wallet trackers and ecosystem feeds.

Fomo / https://t.co/Sd8BcUOzrJ: Set up my personal wallets and share 

Research: Find 10–15 serious candidates → narrow them to 3–5 A-tier asymmetric setups. 

Before buying: EDGE → RANGE → SIZE → INVALIDATION → CATALYST → EXIT.

Journal: Every trade documented before entry. No more buying first and creating the thesis later.

Solo Journey: Learn from everyone. Blindly follow no one. Friends can send me 100 coins, but every coin starts with zero conviction until I research it myself.

Scoreboard: Portfolio, PnL, trades, mistakes, missed opportunities, emotional decisions and what needs to change for Week 2.
